text:
priya: Quick kickoff — NebulaWorks case & webinar. Deliverables: launch blog post, 3-line benchmark blurb, a legal-cleared customer quote, webinar page + slides, and SDR routing. Target window: week of May 12. Draft: https://docs.redwood.com/nebulaworks-launch (please don't edit until we lock quotes)

marie: I'll own the blog copy and the promotional timeline. Need final quote by Tue AM to loop legal.

lina: I'll run webinar ops and build the slide deck. Who's confirmed to present from NebulaWorks? Ideally an engineering lead + product owner.

alex (NebulaWorks): We can provide Eng lead (Maya) and our Head of Product (Liam). Happy to do a short quote and join the panel.

kofi: Can NebulaWorks also share a 20-30s customer clip for socials? raw phone video is fine.

alex (NebulaWorks): Yep, we can record something quick. We'll aim for Wed recording.

sam (growth): Registration form asks: email, company, company size, cloud, interested-in (hosted/dedicated/private). Add hidden utm_campaign=nebula_launch and question: "Evaluating inference infra in next 6 months?" for routing.

zoe (product): I'll review any product claims. If you're calling out 2x throughput and 25% lower token cost, I need the benchmark artifacts to verify.

priya: Good call. Alex — can you attach the benchmark run id(s) and a short note on how the numbers were measured? Legal needs sources.

alex (NebulaWorks): Attaching benchmark_run_0425 and their cost-report link. Quick note: test workload = dialog pipeline with 1-2k active users, p99 measured at steady-state.

legal-bot: Quote & metric verification required. Please submit via legal queue with this template:
- quote_text: "..."
- metric_sources: [benchmark_run_id, internal_report_url]
- embargo_date: yyyy-mm-dd
Submit to: https://legal.redwood.com/review (category: marketing - customer quotes). SLA: 3 business days if complete.

marie: Draft quote (from Alex): "Redwood reduced our per-session inference cost by ~25% and kept p99 under 150ms — enabled us to ship chat to production." Lina / Alex — can we tighten that to avoid modality-specific claims?

alex (NebulaWorks): We can tweak. How about: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~25% while keeping p99 latency under 150ms."

lina: That wording is cleaner. I'll add the quote to the speaker slide and to the blog draft once legal clears.

zoe (product): Approving the claim depends on metric provenance. If NebulaWorks used Redwood batching+KV cache in production emulation, that's fine; attach config/commit IDs.

alex (NebulaWorks): Adding commit id: cb4f2a and the config snippet in the docs link.

priya: Promo cadence proposal: announce blog + webinar registration on Tue, two reminder emails (3 days before, 1 day before), social posts (LinkedIn + X) the day of. Marie, can you draft the email sequences?

marie: Yes — I'll draft and drop them in the doc by Mon EOD. Need the webinar title + speaker bios. Lina, can you add speaker runbook?

lina: On it. Also adding a short rehearsal slot: Wed 10am PST. Alex/Maya/Liam confirm?

alex (NebulaWorks): Wed 10am PST works for us.

sam (growth): SDR routing: tag leads with "nebula_launch" and score enterprise leads (company size>500) > high priority. After event, create nurture sequence for trial offers.

priya: Noted. I'll hand off the lead file to Sam within 24h post-webinar.

legal-bot: Reminder: if legal asks for redlines on quote, allow +2 business days. Recommend submitting final quote and metric sources by Tue 9am to meet May 12 timeline.

marie: Timeline summary: Tue 9am — final quote + metric sources to legal. Tue EOD — product signoff. Wed EOD — final slides + promo assets. Wed/Thu — record clip & rehearsal. Publish week of May 12.

kofi: Adding video pickup to my calendar. I'll coordinate with NebulaWorks for a short shoot.

priya: I'll assemble post-event one-pager and updated benchmark appendix for sales.

lina: I'll circulate slide draft by Tue morning for quick feedback.

alex (NebulaWorks): We'll upload the quote + artifacts to the legal link by Tue 8:45am. Thanks everyone.

marie: Great. Thanks team — I'll follow up with a checklist and move items in the doc to "In progress." :rocket:
